note: How the gallery demonstrates each component. tool/gen_gallery.dart reads this together with ../../contracts/components.manifest.json and fails when the two disagree: every name the manifest claims must appear exactly once, in a demo's `shows`, in `undemoable`, or in `gaps`. The last two are different facts and the coverage page must not blur them -- `undemoable` is permanent and correct (the name has no visual form at all), `gaps` is work not done yet. A component the gallery has not reached needs no entry here (absence is not drift), but a claimed prop is never left silent.

undemoable.props.ariaLabel: An accessible name has no visual form. The sizes demo sets one on every icon-only button because the contract requires it there, but what is announced is asserted by the widget tests, not seen in a gallery.
undemoable.events.click: Every button in every demo carries a live onPressed -- that is the floor this gallery was built to meet. A callback has no appearance of its own to show.

gaps.props.iconPosition: The sizes demo places its icon in the default left position only.
gaps.props.rounded: The axis that matters is the theme-wide default -- KunThemeData.rounded squares or rounds every surface at once, as the web's config.rounded does -- and the gallery has no control for it. The per-widget override is the escape hatch, not the story.
